inputs: clean AgentSwitchboard branch or isolated worktree
parallel tasks with disjoint owned paths
steps: Declare captain/convergence owner and one writer per worker branch/worktree.
Keep +yolo disabled and remote-writing delivery modes out of scope for the first live proof.
Dispatch only bounded tasks with explicit owned/forbidden paths and validators.
Record worker identities, worktree/branch identities, validator receipts, and produced artifacts.
Convergence owner re-inspects diffs before any integration.
Stop before PR creation, merge, deployment, or Herdr promotion unless separately authorized and proved.
failure_handling: Cancel or quarantine only the failing lane; preserve successful disjoint work and route deterministic failures back to the responsible worker.
proof_ceiling: workflow-state evidence only unless the owning runtime/validator produces stronger proof
